_about: What each single-call stage looks up on the web before it writes. Stages that run with tools search for themselves; these are the ones that make one call and cannot.

srs.purpose: write a complete, realistic requirements specification for a product of this kind
srs.wanted: what products of this kind normally do: the features people expect, the records they keep and the fields those records carry, the workflows and their edge cases, the validation rules and limits, and any standard or regulation that commonly applies

prototype.purpose: design an ultra-polished, beautiful clickable prototype of a product of this kind
prototype.wanted: how the best-designed products of this kind look and feel: how their key screens are composed, how colour and type are used, how dense or airy they are, how imagery, illustration, charts and data are shown, and how empty states, loading states, motion and small interactions are handled
